lesson.title: Procedure 429 – RADIO INTERFERENCE / UNAUTHORIZED TRANSMISSIONS
lesson.topic: Radio Dispatching – Interference, Unauthorized Traffic, and Escalation
objectives: Explain why Procedure 429 requires an assertive dispatcher role for field unit safety.
Apply timing standards for accidental transmissions, including the 60-second cutoff.
Apply required on-air warning elements and documentation/notification requirements for unauthorized transmissions.
Apply supervisory escalation timing (15-minute re-notify rule).
Identify how supervisors assess serious misconduct from transmission content.
Apply troubleshooting steps and special handling for aviation requests under unauthorized transmissions.
